# Minimalist Toolkit

Minimalist Toolkit is a web workspace that combines multiple productivity tools in one place.

## Public pages
- / : Product overview and features
- /login : Sign in
- /signup : Create an account

## Workspace tools (after sign-in)
- /app : Dashboard and quick access
- /app/snippets : Save, search, and organize reusable code
- /app/categories : Browse snippet categories
- /app/mockify : Generate visual mockups from text prompts
- /app/promptcraft : Draft and improve prompts
- /app/chat : AI chat for quick help
- /app/settings : Account and appearance preferences

## Notes
- Each tool has its own workflow and page.
- Some features may require additional service configuration.
- User workspace data is intended to remain private to the signed-in account.

Made by Tanveer: https://muhammadtanveerabbas.vercel.app
